```plato

    // The dual face of a vertex: the faces meeting at it, named by the dual
    // vertices they became. Taken in REVERSED rotation order — a face built
    // around a vertex winds opposite to the rotation that generated it, so
    // without the reversal every dual face points inward.
    DualFaceOfVertex(self: PolygonMesh3D, vertex: VertexIndex): Array<VertexIndex>
        => self.ReversedVertexCornerRing(vertex).Map(c => VertexIndex(self.CornerFace(c).Value));
```
